ask_intro: A different price, leaving something out, another day? Ask here and get an answer straight away.
waiting_owner: {owner} is looking at your request. This page updates when they reply.
quote_placeholder: e.g. Could you do it for less?
answers_from: Answers come from {business}'s assistant, within limits {owner} has set.
email_help: PayPal sends your deposit request and receipt here.
fine_deposit: Pay securely by card or PayPal. The balance is invoiced when the job is done.
fine_no_deposit: No deposit needed. You'll be invoiced when the job is done.
accepted_pay: Quote accepted. Pay the deposit to book.
updates_itself: This page updates by itself once you've paid.
in_touch: {business} will be in touch about the job.
get_in_touch: Get in touch with {business} for an up-to-date price.
footer: Payments by PayPal · Sent with SayInvoice
err_no_connection: No connection. Try again; you won't be charged twice.
err_add_email: Add your email in the box below first, so PayPal can send the deposit request.
err_book: Couldn't book it just now. Try again.
err_plan: Couldn't set up the plan just now.
pay_any_amount: Pay any amount from the PayPal invoice: card or PayPal. This page updates once you've paid.
cant_pay: Can't pay it all at once?
plan_intro: Suggest how you'd like to split it, for example “half now and half at the end of the month”, and get an answer straight away.
plan_placeholder: e.g. Half now, half at the end of the month?
not_found_body: The link may be incomplete. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
msg_check_with_owner: Thanks! Let me check that with {owner} and come back to you shortly.
msg_owner_agreed: Good news: {owner} has agreed. Here's the updated quote.
msg_owner_agreed_plan: Good news: {owner} has agreed. Tap “Agree this plan” to confirm.
msg_owner_declined: Sorry, {owner} can't do that one. The quote stands as it is, and you can still accept it below.
msg_owner_declined_plan: Sorry, {owner} can't agree that plan. You can still pay in full from the invoice.
plan_line: Can't pay it all at once? Suggest a payment plan: {url}
reminder_1: Hi {name}, just a friendly reminder that invoice {number} for {amount} is now due. You can pay by card or PayPal from this email. Thank you!
reminder_2: Hi {name}, invoice {number} for {amount} is now {days} days overdue. Could you pay it this week? You can pay by card or PayPal from this email.
reminder_3: Hi {name}, this is a final reminder that invoice {number} for {amount} is still unpaid. Please pay within 7 days, or reply if you'd like to talk about it.
instalment_1: Hi {name}, just a friendly reminder that your payment plan instalment of {amount} for invoice {number} was due on {date}. You can pay it from this email. Thank you!
instalment_2: Hi {name}, your instalment of {amount} for invoice {number} (due {date}) hasn't come through yet. Could you pay it this week?
instalment_3: Hi {name}, this is a final reminder about the {amount} instalment for invoice {number}, due {date}. Please pay within 7 days, or reply to talk about it.
